source_snapshot.procedure: Use amdxio/lspci to identify live PCIe bridge BDFs, disable L1/L0s on each, run the specified BER/ErrCnt/receiver/four-point phase/DAC margin sweep on a comma-separated BDF list.
source_snapshot.criteria: CSV has one row per tested lane (example 8 OAM x16=128), each four-direction ErrCnt <=5, offset columns match parameters and no link downtrains.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO analyzer-only, contradicting the source's executable amdxio method and measurable CSV.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/HIGH; restores amdxio automation with live topology, ASPM approval/restoration, full CSV and link health.

old_problem: Example BDFs/vendor-ID filtering do not establish the physical port/OAM/lane scope; tool/fixture compatibility, live lane cardinality, parameter semantics and ASPM restoration are unspecified. Source log clearing would destroy baseline, while DeepSeek wrongly discards executable amdxio coverage as analyzer-only.
disposition_reason: The source supplies a concrete software margin command and field-level acceptance, so the case is not inherently manual-only. Tool/driver/optional-fixture, BDF-to-physical/lane map and row formula are package inputs. ED-15 retains the explicit <=5 threshold and exact parameter-match rules; ED-11/12 gate ASPM state changes, require per-link restoration and prohibit broad disable or rerun.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2048, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, unique-code result and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next row Functionality 2049 / Wistron-AMD SVM-00488-V003 / f6ccd06a51b9a820 was directly read from XLSX.
amdxio directly performs link margining and emits lane-level CSV, so an analyzer may be a platform dependency but cannot be assumed mandatory absent the approved tool guide.
Live BDFs are topology locations; every target must bind to the intended physical port/device/OAM and negotiated lane width rather than copy the example or select only vendor ID 1500.
Expected row count is the sum of actual approved lane widths, not always 128; every lane must be unique and carry all four error/offset fields.
ASPM L1/L0s is a state change: capture each original state, change only approved targets, monitor link health and restore/verify exactly.
No amdxio/lspci command, ASPM change, margin sweep, CSV generation, link action or DUT operation was performed.

test_case.test_name: Topology-bound PCIe four-point lane margining with ASPM restoration
test_case.purpose: Run the source-defined amdxio four-point screen on every approved PCIe link/lane, validate complete lane-level CSV error/offset data and absence of downtrain, then restore each link's original ASPM state.
required_package: Exact row-2048 variant plus SUT/BIOS/firmware/AMD device and PCIe topology identities
Approved amdxio binary/version/checksum, driver/privilege requirements and documented need for any analyzer/fixture
Signed live BDF-to-physical bridge/port/device/OAM/lane-width map and expected unique-row formula
Approved BER=10, ErrCnt=5, receiver=6, four-point phase/DAC range semantics and CSV schema
Per-link original L1/L0s states, exact disable/restore commands, maintenance authorization, console and recovery
Link speed/width/error, thermal/power abort rules and human verdict owner
test_case.test_command: STATE-CHANGING PACKAGE-GATED; preserve full PCIe/AER/log baseline and verify tool checksum/version. Enumerate ports and bind each live BDF to the signed physical/lane map; do not copy examples or select by vendor ID alone. Record every target's L1/L0s state, obtain explicit ASPM/margin authorization, disable only approved target states, and run the exact source four-point parameters once. Retain complete raw output and CSV. Validate unique lane cardinality, four ErrCnt <=5 fields, four offset parameter matches, device presence, speed/width and no new errors. Restore and verify every original ASPM state even after a controlled failure path; no log clear or auto-rerun.
test_case.expected_result: CSV contains exactly one valid row for every approved physical lane, each Left/Right/Top/Bottom Offset ErrCnt is <=5, all four margin-offset fields match the commanded parameters, all target devices remain present without downtrain/new critical errors, and every link returns to its recorded ASPM state.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires approved tool/topology/parameters, exact unique row cardinality, all per-lane <=5 and parameter-match checks, unchanged accepted link health and complete ASPM restoration. FAIL on wrong/extra/missing/duplicate lane, malformed field, ErrCnt >5, offset drift, downtrain/device loss/new error or restore failure. Missing map/tool/fixture/approval is NOT READY; summary-only evidence cannot PASS.
safety_gate: Change ASPM only on exact signed BDF/physical links after recording original states and recovery; never broaden scope.
Monitor presence, speed, width, AER, thermal and power throughout; stop on downtrain, loss, excessive errors or malformed CSV.
Preserve baseline and complete CSV/output; no log clearing or truncation.
One authorized sweep only; no automatic rerun. Restore each ASPM state and escalate any restoration failure.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/Variant/hash, tool/driver/fixture compatibility and checksum
Signed live BDF/physical/OAM/lane map, negotiated widths and expected-row calculation
Per-link original ASPM evidence, change authorization and exact commands/exits
Complete raw margin output and immutable CSV with schema/hash
Per-lane uniqueness/count, four ErrCnt, four offset and link-health analysis
Verified ASPM restore, no-clear/no-rerun audit, failure recovery and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On wrong target, downtrain, device loss, excessive errors or malformed CSV, stop the sweep and preserve first raw/link/AER state. Restore only each recorded original ASPM setting using the approved command, then verify enumeration and speed/width. Do not rerun or reset/power-cycle automatically; use console recovery under new authorization if restore fails.
